source_item.title: FX options set to expire today across major currency pairs

card.plain_headline: Currency options expiring today could affect exchange rates.
card.what_happened: A significant number of foreign exchange (FX) options contracts are scheduled to expire today across several major currency pairs. The expiration of these options can sometimes influence currency movements as traders adjust their positions or hedge against potential price swings.
card.what_happened_verbose: A substantial volume of foreign exchange (FX) options contracts are due to expire today for key currency pairs. FX options give the holder the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell a currency at a specific price (strike price) on or before a certain date. As these options expire, market participants who wrote (sold) the options may need to unwind their hedges, or those holding in-the-money options might exercise them, potentially leading to increased volatility or price action around the strike prices of the expiring options.
